_comment: Shipped blueprint inventory — every entry dispatches on both rails unless it declares `rails` (#2308, #2304); collection_index, collection_entry, faq_accordion_grouped, hero_centered, hero_statement, features_alternating_split and features_bento_asymmetric declare `["astro"]` (#872, #3186, #3187, #3189, #3188). `is_active: true` means renderable, not catalogued: the designed-but-unbuilt layouts live in blueprint-roadmap.json, which is schema-distinct and carries no is_active flag. Consumers read this file only.

blueprints.name: Split Hero
blueprints.layout_spec: Two-column layout: left 60% contains eyebrow label (12px uppercase, accent color, line before text), display headline (72–96px, font-weight 800, letter-spacing -0.04em, line-height 1.02), single subheading (1 sentence, 17px, muted color), and two CTAs side by side (primary filled + ghost outlined). Right 40% is full-height photography with dark gradient overlay bleeding from left edge. Trust signal (small text, very muted) sits below CTAs separated by a horizontal rule. No body paragraph.
blueprints.css_hints: grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; .hero-photo { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .hero-photo img { height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .hero-photo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--ink) 0%, transparent 30%); }
blueprints.source: Framer - Buildaxa / Vale demo

blueprints.name: Split Hero with Image Card + Price Overlay
blueprints.layout_spec: Two-column 58/42 split on a soft audience-tinted background. Left column (vertical flex stack, gap-md): optional breadcrumb trail (3-5 items, brand-primary text color, '/' separators, last item aria-current=page); optional eyebrow label (uppercase, label-sm, primary text); h1 headline (display, weight bold); optional 1-3 line body paragraph (body-md, secondary text, max-width 55ch); optional single dark CTA button (small padding, dark background, white label — NOT a paired CTA group). Right column: white surface-primary card (radius-lg, soft shadow, padding-md) containing a 4:3 media slot (a real client photo, an accepted Recraft asset, or the `bds-blueprint-section__missing` labelled placeholder — never drawn or generated art) and an optional price overlay block underneath (label 'Starting at' / display price / brand-primary CTA button). Render the price overlay only when the client's own content states that price; otherwise omit the whole block — never invent, estimate or range a price. Background tinting comes from `[data-audience='X'] { --background-brand-primary-soft: ... }` cascade declared by the consumer site — BDS ships the slot, not the values. Drives interior service-detail and similar 'page lives under a category' templates.
blueprints.css_hints: grid-template-columns: 58fr 42fr; gap: var(--bds-gap-huge); .media-card { background: var(--bds-surface-primary); border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-lg); padding: var(--bds-padding-md); box-shadow: var(--bds-shadow-md); } .image-frame { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-md); } [data-audience] { /* consumer-defined cascade */ }
blueprints.source: brikdesigns.com /service/{slug} pages — verified 2026-05-09 audit

blueprints.name: 3-Column Feature Card Grid
blueprints.layout_spec: Dark section background (page-inverse). 3-column grid of cards, each filled with its own brand color via [data-audience='X'] scope binding (re-binds --bds-background-brand-primary per card). Card layout: oversized media slot top (1:1 aspect, ~60-70% of card height, padded inside the brand color) holding a real client photo, an accepted Recraft asset, or the `bds-blueprint-section__missing` labelled placeholder — never drawn or generated art; then card body with high-contrast title (heading/sm, font-weight bold for AA on saturated bg), 1-sentence description (body/sm at 16px regular for large-text 3:1 threshold), and 'Learn more' affordance with arrow. Cards rounded-lg, full-bleed image at top, body padding generous. Section header centered above grid in light text on dark surface. Optional eyebrow above heading. Cards collapse to 2-col at <992px, 1-col at <768px. Each card establishes its own data-audience subtree binding so its --brand-primary cascades correctly per the BDS scope-binding pattern (consumer site defines [data-audience='X'] cascade rules).
blueprints.css_hints: .features-branded-dark { background: var(--bds-page-inverse); padding-block: clamp(var(--bds-padding-xl), 9vw, var(--bds-padding-huge)); color: var(--bds-text-on-color-dark); } .features-branded-dark__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--bds-gap-lg); } .features-branded-dark__card { background: var(--bds-background-brand-primary); border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; } .features-branded-dark__media { aspect-ratio: 1; padding: var(--bds-padding-xl); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .features-branded-dark__body { padding: var(--bds-padding-lg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--bds-gap-md); }
blueprints.source: brikdesigns.com /services/{slug} 'Other Service Lines' cross-sell module (PR #477 spec)

blueprints.name: Alternating Content Splits
blueprints.layout_spec: Page-surface features section: an optional section header (eyebrow, heading, lead) above a single column of rows, one row per item. Each row is two equal columns, a text side and a media side, with a wide gap between them and a wider gap between rows. The text side holds the item heading, a short description and an optional link with an arrow, shown only when the item has a link target. The media side is a 4:3 box with rounded corners holding the item's image cropped to fill, or the `bds-blueprint-section__missing` labelled placeholder when no image is supplied — never drawn or generated art. From the tablet width up, the media side sits after the text on odd rows and before it on even rows; `mediaPosition="start"` starts on the media side instead. Below the tablet width every row stacks text first, then media, with no alternation. DOM order is always text first. Differs from feature_grid (a dark grid of brand-coloured cards, no alternation) and story_split (one narrative with a pull-quote, not repeated rows).
blueprints.css_hints: .bds-features--alternating-split .bds-features__grid { gap: var(--bds-gap-huge); } .bds-features--alternating-split .bds-features__item { display: grid; gap: var(--bds-gap-xl); align-items: center; } .bds-features--alternating-split .bds-features__media { aspect-ratio: var(--bds-aspect-4-3); border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-lg); } .bds-features--alternating-split .bds-features__image { object-fit: cover; }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#3189 — graduated from blueprint-roadmap.json onto the canonical rail (ADR-037)

blueprints.name: Asymmetric Bento Grid
blueprints.layout_spec: Page-surface features section: an optional section header (eyebrow, heading, lead) above an asymmetric card grid. From the desktop width up the grid is three columns sized 2fr 1fr 1fr over two rows; the first item is the featured cell and spans both rows. Every other cell is an equal-size card: a media box (4:3, the item's image cropped to fill, or the `bds-blueprint-section__missing` labelled placeholder when no image is supplied — never drawn or generated art) above the item heading, a short description and an optional link with an arrow. An item that carries a headline figure renders as a stat cell instead: the figure large on the brand fill, with the item heading and description beneath, and no media. Cells have rounded corners. At the tablet width the grid is two columns and the featured cell spans the full row; below it every cell stacks in one column. Differs from feature_grid (a dark grid of equal brand-coloured cards) and features_alternating_split (one text-and-media row per item, no featured cell).
blueprints.css_hints: .bds-features--bento .bds-features__grid { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--bds-gap-lg); } .bds-features--bento .bds-features__item { border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; background: var(--bds-surface-secondary); } .bds-features--bento .bds-features__item--featured { grid-row: span 2; } .bds-features--bento .bds-features__media { aspect-ratio: var(--bds-aspect-4-3); } .bds-features--bento .bds-features__item--stat { background: var(--bds-background-brand-primary); }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#3188 — graduated from blueprint-roadmap.json onto the canonical rail (ADR-037)

blueprints.name: Stats Bar
blueprints.layout_spec: Full-width dark background strip (sits between hero and first content section). 4 metrics in equal columns separated by 1px vertical rules. Each metric: large number (40–48px, 800 weight, white) with colored accent suffix (+ % B yr), label below in small muted text (2 lines max, 13px). No heading — the numbers speak. Counter animation on scroll-into-view.
blueprints.css_hints: .stats-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } .stat-col { padding: 32px 24px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .stat-col:last-child { border-right: none; } .stat-num { font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px); font-weight: 800; }
blueprints.source: Vale demo / Buildaxa

blueprints.name: Featured Large Testimonial
blueprints.layout_spec: Dark or accent-tinted background. Single large testimonial centered. Quote mark (large decorative, accent color, 80px). Quote text is large (20–24px, light weight, italic, white, max 2 lines). Author avatar (60px circle), name, and title below. Optional: 2–3 smaller secondary quotes in a row below the featured quote at smaller size.
blueprints.css_hints: .testimonial-featured { text-align: center; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; } .quote-mark { font-size: 80px; line-height: 1; color: var(--accent); font-family: Georgia, serif; } .quote-text { font-size: clamp(18px, 2vw, 24px); font-style: italic; font-weight: 300; }
blueprints.source: Original research

blueprints.name: Centered CTA
blueprints.layout_spec: Dark background (near-black or brand dark). Radial gradient glow behind content (accent color, low opacity). All content centered. Eyebrow label (uppercase, accent). Heading: 2 lines max, 52–64px, 800 weight. Single subheading sentence (muted, max 50 chars). Two CTAs centered: primary filled + ghost outlined. No body paragraph.
blueprints.css_hints: .cta-section { position: relative; } .cta-section::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 50% 50%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); }
blueprints.source: Vale demo

blueprints.name: Callout Panel — Illustration + Card Split
blueprints.layout_spec: Light section. Centered section header (heading + subhead) above. Below: two-column split, media slot left, plan card right. Media slot: one image or video — a real client photo or video, an accepted Recraft asset, or the `bds-blueprint-section__missing` labelled placeholder. Never compose a persona/scene or floating UI elements (chat bubbles, message tiles), and never draw or generate art. Plan card: surface-secondary background, rounded-lg corners, padded generously. Card content: plan name (heading/sm), 2-sentence description (body/sm, on light), 'Learn more' primary CTA (size md). Two-column collapses to stacked at <992px (media goes above card on mobile). Section also supports a 'media-omitted' variant where the card centers max-width 720px.
blueprints.css_hints: .support-plan-callout { padding-block: clamp(var(--bds-padding-xl), 9vw, var(--bds-padding-huge)); background: var(--bds-page-primary); } .support-plan-callout__split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--bds-gap-xl); align-items: center; } .support-plan-callout__card { background: var(--bds-surface-secondary); border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-lg); padding: var(--bds-padding-xl); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--bds-gap-md); align-items: flex-start; } @media (max-width: 991.98px) { .support-plan-callout__split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
blueprints.source: brikdesigns.com /services/{slug} 'Monthly support services' cross-sell section (PR #477 spec)

blueprints.name: Split CTA with Contact
blueprints.layout_spec: Light background. Two-column layout. Left: heading (2 lines, 40px), 1-sentence subheading, primary CTA button. Right: contact details (phone number large, email, optional address), each with a small icon. Separated by a thin vertical rule. Conveys "we are real, reachable people" rather than just a form prompt.
blueprints.css_hints: .cta-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1px 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; } .cta-divider { background: var(--rule-light); align-self: stretch; }
blueprints.source: Original research

blueprints.name: Centered Hero
blueprints.layout_spec: Single centred column with no media, opening a page. Optional eyebrow, then an h1 headline, an optional body paragraph and an optional single call to action, all centred in a narrow column. Any background glow comes from the resolved atmosphere (cinematic-dramatic paints a centred radial glow behind the hero) or from the consumer's hero background hook, never from the layout. Pairs with a following stats_bar or logo_wall for proof. Drives home and campaign landing pages that lead with one message.
blueprints.css_hints: .bds-hero--centered .bds-hero__container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--bds-gap-md); max-width: var(--bds-content-width-md); } .bds-hero--centered .bds-hero__content { align-items: center; text-align: center; }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#3186 — graduated from blueprint-roadmap.json onto the canonical rail (ADR-037)

blueprints.name: Statement Hero
blueprints.layout_spec: Left-aligned opening section on the page surface. A short eyebrow label is preceded by a short horizontal rule. Below it a headline of three to five words at display size, then one primary call to action. An optional lead paragraph renders if supplied but the layout is built to stand without one. When a decoration is slotted, a right column holds a single abstract shape or minimal illustration (hidden from assistive tech); without one the content column keeps the full width and the right side stays empty. Stacks to one column on narrow screens. The surface and all text colours come from the active theme mode, so the same markup renders light or dark; atmosphere is layered on top, never part of the layout. Differs from hero_interior_minimal (a compact banner with no call to action) and hero_split (which requires an image).
blueprints.css_hints: .bds-hero--statement .bds-hero__subtitle::before { width: var(--bds-size-1200); border-top: var(--bds-border-width-sm) solid currentColor; } .bds-hero--statement .bds-hero__title { font-size: clamp(var(--bds-heading-xxl), 7vw, var(--bds-display-lg)); font-weight: var(--bds-font-weight-bold); }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#3187 — graduated from blueprint-roadmap.json onto the canonical rail (ADR-037)

blueprints.name: Interior Page Hero — Minimal Banner
blueprints.layout_spec: Compact banner hero for interior pages (About, Services, Contact). Full-width section, 200–280px tall. Left-aligned breadcrumb (very small, muted) above a large page headline (48–60px, 800 weight, ink color). Optional one-sentence subheading below (muted, 16px). No CTA. Background is either solid brand-light fill or subtle diagonal stripe texture. Transitions page context before the main content area begins.
blueprints.css_hints: .interior-hero { padding: 56px 0 40px; background: var(--surface-brand-subtle, var(--bds-surface-secondary)); } .interior-hero h1 { font-size: clamp(40px, 5vw, 60px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .breadcrumb { font-size: 12px; color: var(--bds-text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 12px; }
blueprints.source: Original research

blueprints.name: Story Split
blueprints.layout_spec: Two-column layout for About / Story sections: left 55% is body content — eyebrow label, H2 headline (36–44px, 700 weight), 2–3 short paragraphs, optional values list as small icon + label rows. Right 45% is a single portrait or team photo in a tall card with rounded corners (16px radius), optional overlapping stat chip (e.g. "12 years in business") positioned bottom-left of the photo. Vertical rhythm: section is 100–120px tall padding.
blueprints.css_hints: .about-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55fr 45fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; } .about-photo { border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .stat-chip { position: absolute; bottom: -20px; left: 24px; background: white; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }
blueprints.source: Original research

blueprints.name: Two-Column Detail Grid
blueprints.layout_spec: Services or offerings detail layout. Section heading + subheading centered at top. Below: 2-column grid of service cards (3–6 cards typical). Each card: icon top-left (32px, accent color), service name (18px, 600 weight), 2-sentence description (14px, muted), optional price or tier badge bottom-right, optional "Learn more" text link at bottom. Cards have subtle border (1px rule color), 16px radius, 28px internal padding. Hover: elevate with box-shadow transition.
blueprints.css_hints: .services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; } .service-card { border: 1px solid var(--bds-border-primary); border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .service-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
blueprints.source: Original research

blueprints.name: 3-Column Card Grid
blueprints.layout_spec: Light background section. Centered section header (eyebrow optional + heading + optional one-line subhead). 3-column grid of service cards below. Each card: top image area (3:2 aspect) showing service-specific 3D illustration or photo on a light backdrop; below, a small ServiceTag (icon variant, accent color) + service name (heading/sm, 700 weight) + 1-2 sentence description (body/sm, on light) + 'Learn more' ghost-variant link-button. Optional 'Has Options' positive-status badge anchored top-right of card when the service exposes multiple offerings. Cards have rounded corners (border-radius-md), no border at rest, optional subtle hover lift. Grid gap is generous (24-28px). Collapses to 2-col at <992px, 1-col at <768px.
blueprints.css_hints: .services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--bds-gap-lg); } .service-card { background: var(--bds-surface-primary); border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-md); overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .service-card__media { aspect-ratio: 3/2; background: var(--bds-surface-secondary); } .service-card__body { padding: var(--bds-padding-lg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--bds-gap-md); } .service-card__has-options { position: absolute; top: var(--bds-gap-md); right: var(--bds-gap-md); }
blueprints.source: brikdesigns.com /services/{slug} index pages — service-line card grid pattern (PR #477 spec)

blueprints.name: Logo Wall
blueprints.layout_spec: Logo / partner / trust strip. Optional centered uppercase eyebrow heading (label/lg, muted) above a row of client/partner logos. Each item is one logo image (consumer supplies a pre-monochromed SVG/PNG), optionally linked. Two motion modes via the content-motion axis (ADR-039): default `none` renders a centered wrapped flex row; `contentMotion: marquee` scrolls the strip through the Marquee primitive (seamless loop, reduced-motion-gated by construction — the track stops and wraps under prefers-reduced-motion). Logo height ~24px, generous gap (~40px). Section-driven; no required client facts.
blueprints.css_hints: .bp-logo-wall__strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--bds-size-1000); } .bp-logo-wall__strip[data-motion='marquee'] { display: block; } /* marquee scroll owned by the bds-marquee primitive */
blueprints.source: ADR-039 §Decision 2 — content-motion axis, first marquee adopter (brik-bds#2529)

blueprints.name: Collection Index
blueprints.layout_spec: Section header (optional eyebrow, h2 title, optional lead) above a responsive grid of entry cards (1 column, 2 from 768px, 3 from 992px). Each card is an article: optional 3:2 image, optional service-line category label, h3 title that is the card's single stretched link, and the excerpt. No date is rendered — the item shape carries none. Lists blog posts, resources, case studies or news.
blueprints.css_hints: .bp-collection-index__list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--bds-gap-lg); } .bp-collection-index__card { position: relative; border: var(--bds-border-width-md) solid var(--bds-border-secondary); border-radius: var(--bds-border-radius-md); } .bp-collection-index__link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#872 — Astro-only block on the canonical rail (ADR-037)

blueprints.name: Collection Entry
blueprints.layout_spec: Article detail for one collection entry. Section header (optional eyebrow, h2 title) above a single text-width column of long-form body. Body is plain text parsed into structure: blank lines split paragraphs, '## ' lines become h3, '### ' lines become h4, '- ' lines become a bulleted list. Rendered as text nodes only, never as HTML. No image: the item shape carries no per-entry image.
blueprints.css_hints: .bp-collection-entry__article { max-width: var(--bds-content-width-text-md); margin-inline: auto; } .bp-collection-entry__content > * + * { margin-top: var(--bds-gap-md); } .bp-collection-entry__content > * + :is(h3, h4) { margin-top: var(--bds-gap-xl); }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#872 — Astro-only block on the canonical rail (ADR-037)

blueprints.name: FAQ — Grouped Accordion
blueprints.layout_spec: Section header (optional eyebrow, h2 title, optional lead) above FAQ items grouped under h3 topic headings, in order of first appearance; items with no group render ungrouped, and with no groups at all the block is one flat list. Each item is a native details/summary disclosure: question in label-lg semibold on the summary with a decorative chevron that rotates when open, answer in body-md secondary text, items separated by a bottom border. Column capped at the text content width. No JavaScript.
blueprints.css_hints: .bp-faq-accordion__groups { max-width: var(--bds-content-width-text-md); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--bds-gap-xl); } .bp-faq-accordion__item { border-bottom: var(--bds-border-width-sm) solid var(--bds-border-secondary); } .bp-faq-accordion__question { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .bp-faq-accordion__item[open] > .bp-faq-accordion__question::after { transform: rotate(-135deg); }
blueprints.source: brik-bds#872 — Astro-only block, promoted from the roadmap candidate of the same key
